lessons.title: What are Models?

lessons.description: Create a simple model with fields and learn about common field types.

lessons.title: Migrations: Bringing Models to Life
lessons.description: Turn your model definitions into actual database tables using Django's migration system.

lessons.title: The Django ORM: Querying Data
lessons.description: Learn how to create, retrieve, update, and delete records using Python code.

lessons.title: Relationships Between Models
lessons.description: Connect models with ForeignKey, ManyToManyField, and OneToOneField.

lessons.title: Model Methods & Meta Options
